wm4-dev-technical-01.DTC1: An ETag lets the client validate its stored JSON response.
wm4-dev-technical-01.DTC2: The server supplies the ETag with the response, and the client sends that value in If-None-Match on a later conditional GET.
wm4-dev-technical-01.DTC3: If the tag matches the selected representation, the server returns 304 Not Modified with no response body, so the client can reuse its stored body.
wm4-dev-technical-01.DTC4: If it does not match, an otherwise successful GET returns 200 OK with the current JSON.
wm4-dev-technical-01.DTC5: That validation still sends a request.
wm4-dev-technical-01.DTC6: To permit reuse without validation while the response is fresh, configure an appropriate freshness policy, for example Cache-Control: max-age=60, subject to the other caching rules.
wm4-dev-technical-01.DTC7: Fresh reuse does not guarantee that the underlying data will stay unchanged for 60 seconds.
